codingDoctrine.fixAssessment: Root cause: two reads re-walk history they already read on every GM command: the heal pass reads the whole log (bindCampaignSyncConnection.ts:877 at the baseline) and every highest-sequence read pages the whole stream, hydrating each row (campaignJournalReads.ts:48-67), called by the AdvanceDay gate, the commit and the adoption. Fix: each reads only past the position it last read: the heal pass keeps a per-entry next-unread sequence plus the removals read so far and re-applies all kept removals every pass; the journal store keeps the last head it read per campaign and pages on from its revision (an index seek on UNIQUE(stream_type, stream_id, branch_id, stream_revision)).
removed: a new journal method or head port: src/lib/events is read-only here, and the since-revision read on the existing readStream serves the same index
a host-side cached head: another writer (the HTTP command route, the adoption PUT) would turn it into stale-head refusals; the store-side head is a lower bound always followed by a read
an event-type index or a separate removals table: the kept removals list absorbs it
any change to the re-apply: every committed removal is still re-applied on every pass, as before
codingDoctrine.scope: the heal pass of the campaign socket binder and JournalCampaignEventStore.highestSequence (every caller of it: commit, gate, adoption, open, authority resolution). The grant wake projection and the record rewrite fold are projections, not head reads; they are measured and recorded as findings, not changed.
